classification.difficultyReason: Plot each point and place its image at the same horizontal position and equal distance on the opposite side of the x-axis.

content.prompt: Plot these points on a number plane. Find their images when reflected in the $x$-axis.

spec.description: Authored shared number-plane drawing region; the printed question supplies no graph. Unit square grid with labelled Cartesian axes.
spec.mathematics: Both axes cover every original and reflected point; grid step is 1.
spec.answerVisibility: No original or image points are supplied.

answer.worked: Plot $A(3,-2)$. Mark its image on the same vertical grid line, 2 units above the $x$-axis, giving $A'(3,2)$.
Plot $B(3,2)$. Mark its image on the same vertical grid line, 2 units below the $x$-axis, giving $B'(3,-2)$.
Plot $C(-2,1)$. Mark its image on the same vertical grid line, 1 unit below the $x$-axis, giving $C'(-2,-1)$.

spec.description: Complete shared solution plot, including coincident original and image points.
spec.answerVisibility: All original points and requested reflected images appear only in the answer editions.
